justification: Modifies DCP extraction flagging logic and watchdog alert classification. Wrong logic could silently suppress real value changes from being reviewed.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_setback_controls table: needs_review, review_reason, last_verified_at, reviewed_at columns. dcp_chapter_registry table: check_failures column tracks consecutive download failures.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumes diff changed list has_numeric_change correctly detects all numeric value changes. Verified: _extract_numbers at line 614 matches \d+(?:\.\d+)? with units — covers setbacks, heights, areas, percentages.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Modifies existing flagging path in extract_chapter(). Adds _auto_verify_controls() helper. No new tables or columns. Applies to all future extractions — existing needs_review=TRUE rows with review_reason=chapter_pdf_changed remain until manually cleared.

functions.name: _auto_verify_controls
functions.input: cursor, connection, council str, chapter_key str, reason str
functions.output: UPDATE on dcp_setback_controls: sets needs_review=FALSE, last_verified_at=NOW()
functions.if_none: council or chapter_key None would match zero rows — no-op, no error

values.if_missing: Empty changed list → any() returns False → auto-verify path (safe default)

queries.purpose: Auto-verify control rows when no numeric changes detected
queries.where_clause: WHERE lga = %s AND source_chapter_key = %s AND is_current = TRUE
queries.if_zero: No matching controls — prints nothing, no error
queries.if_wrong: Impossible: scoped by exact lga + chapter_key + is_current

queries.purpose: Find failing chapters with grace period for transient outages
queries.if_zero: No failing chapters — no alert sent (correct behavior)
queries.if_wrong: Only returns active chapters with 3+ failures — cannot include inactive or recently-recovered chapters

break_it.scenario: Real numeric change (setback 6m -> 4.5m) — would smart flagging catch it?
break_it.what_happens: _extract_numbers detects ['6'] vs ['4.5'], has_numeric_change=True, flags for review with reason numeric_value_changed
break_it.how: scripts/dcp_extract_changed.py:1262-1268 — has_numeric_change computed per-provision in diff_provisions
break_it.repro: Change a provision numeric value in DB, re-extract, verify needs_review=TRUE

break_it.scenario: Restructure with only text reformatting and no adds/removes — would it false-alarm?
break_it.what_happens: status=restructure but has_structural=False (0 added, 0 removed), so auto-verified not flagged

break_it.scenario: Numeric change hidden in a newly added provision (not in changed list)
break_it.what_happens: In restructure with additions, structural_change reason triggers flag. In ok status, new provisions have no linked control rows anyway.
break_it.how: Structural change flagging covers restructure case. Normal additions are pagination artifacts with no control row linkage.
break_it.repro: Add a provision with numeric values to a chapter, run extraction in restructure mode

break_it.scenario: Find failing chapters with grace period query returns wrong chapters or misses real failures
break_it.what_happens: check_failures increments to 1, then 2 on subsequent runs. Alert only fires at >= 3 failures. Transient 1-2 day outages never reach Telegram. Real persistent failures always reach 3+.
break_it.how: scripts/dcp_watchdog.py:82 — WHERE check_failures >= 3 AND is_active = TRUE. R2 content monitor resets check_failures to 0 on successful download, so recovered chapters drop out automatically.
break_it.repro: Set check_failures=2 for a chapter, run watchdog — should not alert. Set to 3 — should alert.

post_merge.manual_verify: Next watchdog run should show severity-tiered alerts. Existing review_reason=chapter_pdf_changed rows appear as STANDARD.
